lines.text: Daniel mourns for three full weeks, and on the twenty-fourth day of the first month he stands by the Tigris.
Daniel sees a man in linen with a gold belt from Ophir, and his companions run and hide.
Daniel loses his strength and falls into a deep sleep, then a hand touches him and he stands.
The prince of Persia opposed the speaker for twenty-one days, then Gabriel came to help him.
Daniel becomes speechless, one like a man touches and strengthens him, and says he must fight the prince of Persia.
